findings.location: source.html and translation.html: the five quoted Scripture passages in paragraphs 18, 20 (two passages), 21, and 27
findings.source_quote: “...it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire” (Mar 9:47); “But let it [the adornment] be the hidden man of the heart...” (1Pe 3:4-5); “...woe to that [wo]man by whom the offence cometh!” (Mat 18:7); “Who is a wise [wo]man and endued with knowledge among you?” (Jas 3:13); “...that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly...” (Tit 2:12).
findings.suggested_fix: These are genuine quoted Scripture passages, but scripture_evidence contains no corresponding quote entries and scripture_selections is empty. Obtain the required approved evidence for these quotations, then replace each quoted passage with the exact corresponding target-edition substring(s), preserving its omissions, ellipses, reference identity, placement, and HTML structure. Supply one scripture_selections item per evidence quote; do not generate Scripture wording without the evidence.
findings.translation_quote: “... det er bedre for deg å gå inn i Guds rike med ett øye ...” (Mark 9:47); “Men la det være hjertets skjulte menneske ...” (1 Pet 3:4–5); “... ve det mennesket som forårsaker fallet!” (Matt 18:7); “Hvem er vis og forstandig blant dere?” (Jak 3:13); “... at vi skal fornekte ugudelighet og verdslige lyster ...” (Tit 2:12).
